stackDivergence.rationale: Task153 implements actual SvxCaseMapItem/SvxScriptHintItem/SvxOpticalSizingItem constructor/copy/concrete Clone/value/typed member contracts on existing shared enum/bool/Any owners. Case mapping has exact6native declarations and actual5IDL short constants: queries map4modes explicitly and otherwise NONE, while unsigned16 property writes accept only5published values, ignoring member. Script hint uses the actual5fixed-unsigned16 native aliases over real5IDL constants and MID_SCRIPTHINT0, with original byte/twips selector mask, unknown untouched success and unsigned16 extraction without declared-enum range validation. Native argument narrowing is explicit through JS bit operations; no wrapper identity or type-provider facade. Optical sizing reuses real bool transport and no factory absent from native declarations is invented. Existing inherited scalar queries remain explicit browser bindings. Actual EditEngine defaults4071NotMapped/4075Automatic/4076false are source-backed witnesses, not a dummy pool. Original scripthintitem.hxx includes i18nutil/scriptchangescanner.hxx and Library_editeng links i18nutil; only this native dependency edge is admitted, reverse/browser guards retained and all existing dependency/cycle function bodies unchanged. Original451line textitem owner cannot fit this full value family under500, so canonical3headers reexport a necessary source responsibility split. ScriptHintType declaration is not a script scanner, case-mode storage is not a casing engine, optical bool is not a font-axis provider; no ICU/native ownership manager is added. Localized GetPresentation/GetValueText/resources and diagnostics/instance caches remain unported. Source accepts out-of-enum hints; do not silently clamp them. UI localization and actual EditEngine/EditTextObject/ScPageHFItem/Calc pool/model/connected UI/same-model ODS remain pending; statuses and deliberate I/O/recovery deviations unchanged.
